instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use Outfit for headers, Plus Jakarta Sans for body, and JetBrains Mono for numbers/tickers.
Implement the 'Since Your Last Visit' intelligence engine prominently on the dashboard.
Ensure responsive layout for mobile and desktop viewports.
Use sonner for toasts and shadcn primitives for modals, dropdowns, and tabs.
universal_guidelines: Never use pure black; use #0B0F17 as base and #131822 for cards.
Ensure high contrast accessibility on all text elements.
Add generous spacing (p-6 to p-8) on cards and containers.
